existingCleanupWindow.scope: Exercise continuation inside the existing logical cleanup deadline; not a wall-time speed benchmark.

confirmedCauses: Exact hashes of PNG compression bytes and floating-point geometry were platform-sensitive; compare decoded pixels and rounded numeric geometry while retaining exact topology.

A test froze performance.now(), which is also the HiGHS Emscripten clock. Native time limits never expired and mock call recording exhausted memory. The test now advances real time during native solving.

Many photographic quality regressions combine a tight wall-clock budget with a particular fitted result. Slower or differently warmed runtimes reach different checkpoints. Extra-time runs diagnose this; they do not establish normal-budget success.

Short requests spent the partial-feature winner's refinement reserve on speculative feature initialization and an alternate clearance comparison. Commit 3c8480b2 gives its selected grid the first refinement window.
A fast-found grid in a long request could lose its full-resolution polish to the initial ten-second search deadline, despite ample unused caller time.

A late feature start reserved 450 ms for a polish that could no longer start after assessment. Lending that time to its unfinished refinement improved the source fit without extending the ten-second request.

The Viking continuation repeatedly gave the whole 400 ms repair allowance to hidden-only controls, starving the existing general-control fallback. A local split-budget experiment reduced independent error from 0.01941875 to 0.0186625 without extending the continuation.
remaining: Main remains red and no recovery commit has been merged into main. Best completed full cold-process replay passed 1105/1114 tests. More recent focused runs still fail. Rejected paper-audit reuse has been reverted. The narrowed verification reserve and matching priority fixes are now undergoing full Linux replay at 39170676301. No full-suite or release pass is claimed; NN work has not resumed.

remainingPatterns: Fresh fits with short deadlines fail their independent image-quality or feature-retention gates on the Linux runner. Do not remove those gates or report the extra-time runs as normal-budget passes.

Late-cleanup continuation may now use an existing cleanup remainder. A faster run can legitimately continue without extending its deadline; tests must check the actual budget instead of requiring an absent continuation.
